title: "Revision"
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(tableone)
library(gtsummary)
library(survival)
library(tidycmprsk)
library(ggsurvfit)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

data_dir <- "data"
all <- read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "All_edited_new_12142022.xlsx"))

site_files <- c("Baylor0913", "Indiana0913", "Jacksonville0913", "Kentukey0913",
                "MCW0913", "MGH0913", "Michigan0913", "Oschner0913",
                "Rochester0913", "USC0913", "Yale0913")

read_site <- function(name) {
  df <- read_excel(file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, ".xlsx")))
  if (name == "USC0913") df <- df %>% mutate(rrt_crrt = NA, days_icu = NA, cpr_given = NA)
  df %>% select(study_id, race, rrt_crrt, days_icu, cpr_given)
}
race_added <- bind_rows(lapply(site_files, read_site))
all <- merge(all, race_added, by = "study_id", all.x = TRUE)

all <- all %>%
  mutate(
    type_of_aki = case_when(
      final_type_of_aki == 1 ~ "Prerenal",
      final_type_of_aki == 2 ~ "HRS-AKI",
      final_type_of_aki == 3 ~ "ATN",
      final_type_of_aki == 4 ~ "Other",
      final_type_of_aki == 5 ~ "Unable to diagnosis"),
    etiology_cirrhosis = case_when(
      etiology_cirrhosis == 1 ~ "Alcohol",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 2 ~ "Hepatitis C",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 3 ~ "MASLD",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 5 ~ "Multifactorial",
      etiology_cirrhosis %in% c(4, 6, 7) ~ "Other"),
    race_cat_4 = case_when(
      ethnicity == 2 & race == 5 ~ "NHW",
      ethnicity == 1 & race == 5 ~ "HW",
      ethnicity %in% c(1, 2) & race == 3 ~ "Black",
      ethnicity %in% c(1, 2) & race %in% c(1, 2, 4, 6) ~ "NWNB"),
    race = case_when(
      race == 1 ~ "American Indian or Alaska Native",
      race == 2 ~ "Asian",
      race == 3 ~ "Black or African American",
      race == 4 ~ "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
      race == 5 ~ "White",
      race == 6 ~ "Other",
      race == 7 ~ "Unknown"),
    ethnicity = ifelse(ethnicity == 1, "Hispanic",
                ifelse(ethnicity == 2, "Non-Hispanic", "Unknown")),
    female = ifelse(sex == 2, 1, 0)
  )

calculate_meld3 <- function(female, bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin) {
  if (anyNA(c(female, bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin)) ||
      any(c(bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin) <= 0)) return(NA)
  1.33 * female + 4.56 * log(bilirubin) +
    0.82 * (137 - sodium) - 0.24 * (137 - sodium) * log(bilirubin) +
    9.09 * log(inr) + 11.14 * log(creatinine) +
    1.85 * (3.5 - albumin) - 1.83 * (3.5 - albumin) * log(creatinine) + 6
}

all <- all %>%
  mutate(meld_3 = mapply(calculate_meld3,
                         female, tb_admit, na_admit, inr_admit,
                         creatinine_admission, alb_admit))

n_total <- nrow(all)

step1 <- all %>% filter(race != "Unknown")
n1 <- nrow(step1)

step2 <- step1 %>% filter(ethnicity != "Unknown")
n2 <- nrow(step2)

step3 <- step2 %>%
  mutate(MELD_Na_baseline = replace_na(MELD_Na_baseline, median(MELD_Na_baseline, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(MELD_Na_baseline >= 0)
n3 <- nrow(step3)

step4 <- step3 %>% filter(!is.na(meld_3))
n4 <- nrow(step4)

adjuster_vars <- c("age_admission", "etiology_cirrhosis", "hcc_admission",
                    "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site")
comorb_detail <- sapply(adjuster_vars, function(v) sum(is.na(step4[[v]])))

master <- step4 %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(adjuster_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
n5 <- nrow(master)

cat_var <- c("sex", "race_cat_4", "etiology_cirrhosis", "hcc_admission",
             "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site",
             "ascites_admission", "encephalopathy_admission",
             "type_of_aki", "aclf_grade", "status_90days")
for (v in intersect(cat_var, names(master))) master[[v]] <- as.factor(master[[v]])

master$race_cat_4 <- relevel(master$race_cat_4, ref = "NHW")
master$etiology_cirrhosis <- relevel(master$etiology_cirrhosis, ref = "Alcohol")
master$status_90days <- factor(master$status_90days)

master <- master %>%
  mutate(
    age_10 = age_admission / 10,
    meld_3_5 = meld_3 / 5,
    death_status_90days = ifelse(status_90days == 1, 1, 0)
  )

master_hrs <- master %>% filter(type_of_aki == "HRS-AKI")
```

## Exclusion Cascade

```{r}
comorb_nonzero <- comorb_detail[comorb_detail > 0]
comorb_note <- if (length(comorb_nonzero) > 0) {
  paste0(" (", paste(names(comorb_nonzero), comorb_nonzero, sep = " ", collapse = ", "), ")")
} else ""

exclusion_df <- tibble(
  Step = c(
    "Original HARMONY cohort",
    "  Excluded: Race unknown or not reported",
    "Remaining after race exclusion",
    "  Excluded: Ethnicity unknown or not reported",
    "Remaining after ethnicity exclusion",
    "  Excluded: MELD_Na_baseline < 0",
    "Remaining after MELD_Na_baseline filter",
    "  Excluded: Any element(s) of MELD 3.0 missing or non-positive",
    "Remaining after MELD 3.0 exclusion",
    paste0("  Excluded: Missing baseline covariates", comorb_note),
    "**Final cohort for analysis**",
    "  of which HRS-AKI sub-cohort"
  ),
  N = c(
    n_total,
    n_total - n1,
    n1,
    n1 - n2,
    n2,
    n2 - n3,
    n3,
    n3 - n4,
    n4,
    n4 - n5,
    n5,
    nrow(master_hrs)
  )
)

check_sum <- (n_total - n1) + (n1 - n2) + (n2 - n3) + (n3 - n4) + (n4 - n5)

kable(exclusion_df, caption = paste0(
  "Cohort exclusion cascade — total excluded: ", check_sum,
  ", verification: ", n_total, " − ", check_sum, " = ", n_total - check_sum))
```

## Table 3: Competing Risk Models — Full Cohort {.tabset}

Age reported per 10-year increment; MELD 3.0 reported per 5-point increment. All models adjusted for study site.

```{r}
var_labels <- list(
  race_cat_4 = "Race-ethnicity",
  age_10 = "Age (per 10 years)",
  meld_3_5 = "MELD 3.0 (per 5 points)",
  etiology_cirrhosis = "Etiology of cirrhosis",
  hcc_admission = "HCC",
  diabetes = "Diabetes",
  cad = "CAD",
  ckd = "CKD",
  htn = "Hypertension"
)

binary_vars <- c("hcc_admission", "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn")

uv <- master %>%
  select(race_cat_4, age_10, meld_3_5, etiology_cirrhosis,
         hcc_admission, diabetes, cad, ckd, htn,
         time_90days, status_90days) %>%
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = tidycmprsk::crr,
    y = Surv(time_90days, status_90days),
    method.args = list(failcode = 1, cencode = 0),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3),
    show_single_row = all_of(binary_vars),
    label = var_labels
  ) %>% bold_p() %>% bold_labels()

mv1 <- tidycmprsk::crr(
  Surv(time_90days, status_90days) ~ race_cat_4 + age_10 + meld_3_5 +
    etiology_cirrhosis + hcc_admission + site,
  failcode = 1, cencode = 0,
  data = master
) %>% tbl_regression(
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3),
  show_single_row = "hcc_admission",
  label = var_labels,
  include = c(race_cat_4, age_10, meld_3_5, etiology_cirrhosis, hcc_admission)
) %>% bold_p() %>% bold_labels()

mv2 <- tidycmprsk::crr(
  Surv(time_90days, status_90days) ~ race_cat_4 + age_10 + meld_3_5 +
    etiology_cirrhosis + hcc_admission + diabetes + cad + ckd + htn + site,
  failcode = 1, cencode = 0,
  data = master
) %>% tbl_regression(
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3),
  show_single_row = all_of(binary_vars),
  label = var_labels,
  include = c(race_cat_4, age_10, meld_3_5, etiology_cirrhosis, hcc_admission, diabetes, cad, ckd, htn)
) %>% bold_p() %>% bold_labels()

tbl_merge(
  list(uv, mv1, mv2),
  tab_spanner = c("Univariate", "Multivariable Model 1", "Multivariable Model 2")
)
```

## Figure 2: Cumulative Incidence of Death — Full Cohort

Unadjusted (univariable) cumulative incidence of death through 90 days by race-ethnicity, treating liver transplantation as the competing event. Overall p-value is from **Gray's test** — the CIF analogue of the log-rank test — testing the null that all four CIFs are equal.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
cif_all <- cuminc(Surv(time_90days, status_90days) ~ race_cat_4, data = master)

# Extract Gray's test p-value for the death outcome (outcome code "1")
gray_all <- cif_all$cmprsk$Tests
p_gray_all <- gray_all[rownames(gray_all) == "1", "pv"]
gray_label_all <- paste0("Gray's test p = ", style_pvalue(p_gray_all, digits = 3))

ggcuminc(cif_all, outcome = "1") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, 30), limits = c(0, 90)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Cumulative incidence of death",
    title = "Cumulative incidence of death through 90 days by race-ethnicity (full cohort)",
    color = "Race-ethnicity"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.95, label = gray_label_all,
           hjust = 0, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_minimal() +
  add_risktable()
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
ggcuminc(cif_hrs, outcome = "1") +

```

## Fine & Gray Model — Race × Liver Transplant Listed Interaction

Fine & Gray competing-risk regression with **death as the main outcome** (liver transplantation as the competing event). Unadjusted model testing `race_cat_4 × liver_transplant_listed` interaction only — no other covariates.

```{r}
library(cmprsk)

master_int <- master %>%
  filter(!is.na(liver_transplant_listed)) %>%
  mutate(
    lt_listed = factor(liver_transplant_listed,
                       levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("Not listed", "Listed")),
    status_num = as.numeric(as.character(status_90days))
  )

x_int <- model.matrix(~ race_cat_4 * lt_listed, data = master_int)[, -1]

fg_int <- cmprsk::crr(
  ftime = master_int$time_90days,
  fstatus = master_int$status_num,
  cov1 = x_int,
  failcode = 1, cencode = 0
)
```

### Sub-hazard ratios

```{r}
s <- summary(fg_int)
coef_tbl <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)
coef_tbl$Variable <- rownames(coef_tbl)
pvals <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(s$coef[, "z"])))
coef_tbl$p <- pvals[match(coef_tbl$Variable, names(pvals))]

coef_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    Variable,
    sHR = sprintf("%.2f", `exp(coef)`),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    p = style_pvalue(p, digits = 3)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Fine & Gray: race × LT-listed interaction (unadjusted, death as main outcome, liver transplant as competing event)")
```

### Wald test for the interaction block

```{r}
int_terms <- grep(":", colnames(x_int), value = TRUE)
idx <- which(colnames(x_int) %in% int_terms)

b <- fg_int$coef[idx]
V <- fg_int$var[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
wald <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(V) %*% b)
df_wald <- length(b)
p_wald <- pchisq(wald, df = df_wald, lower.tail = FALSE)

tibble(
  Test = "Wald test for race_cat_4 × lt_listed interaction",
  `Chi-sq` = sprintf("%.3f", wald),
  df = df_wald,
  `p-value` = style_pvalue(p_wald, digits = 3)
) %>% kable()
```

### Race sub-hazard ratios stratified by LT-listed status

```{r}
fg_by_lt <- lapply(levels(master_int$lt_listed), function(lvl) {
  dat <- master_int %>% filter(lt_listed == lvl)
  x <- model.matrix(~ race_cat_4, data = dat)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  x <- x[, apply(x, 2, function(col) length(unique(col)) > 1), drop = FALSE]
  fit <- try(cmprsk::crr(
    ftime = dat$time_90days,
    fstatus = as.numeric(as.character(dat$status_90days)),
    cov1 = x,
    failcode = 1, cencode = 0
  ), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  s <- summary(fit)
  out <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)
  out$Variable <- rownames(out)
  out$p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(s$coef[, "z"])))[match(out$Variable, rownames(s$coef))]
  out$Stratum <- lvl
  out
})

bind_rows(fg_by_lt) %>%
  transmute(
    Stratum, Variable,
    sHR = sprintf("%.2f", `exp(coef)`),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    p = style_pvalue(p, digits = 3)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Unadjusted race sub-hazard ratios stratified by listing for liver transplant")
```
